summary: Practise emergency fund authorization, transaction testing and reconciliation controls. Review the course outline and see how it fits your role.
lede: Emergency fund governance sets controls for authorizing, allocating, disbursing and reporting urgent funds. It is for finance controllers, internal auditors and emergency programme managers who oversee fund decisions and evidence. Learners apply COSO control principles to map release authority, test eligibility and payment records, reconcile disbursements and track exceptions for reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who authorize, administer, review or report emergency fund use, particularly at an intermediate level. It connects fund decisions to the evidence and controls that finance, programme and assurance teams handle at work.
modules: Emergency Fund Governance and COSO Control Environment
COSO Risk Assessment for Emergency Funds
OECD Budget Governance and Assurance Controls
Emergency Fund Dashboard and Control Action Plan
prerequisites: Prior experience in finance, budgeting, internal audit, procurement, emergency programme administration or fund oversight is expected. No coding or programming is required; practical spreadsheet exercises use Excel.
